# ADAM v1.0 RC2 Engineering Contract

- Version: `1.0.0-rc2`
- Software classification: complete bounded artificial living data-universe reference
- Production certification: external evidence required
- Frozen parent: qualified v0.51 source candidate and v0.50.1 R4 lineage
- Authority rule: official mutation occurs only through validated reactions
- Trust rule: candidate, witness, assessor and membership signatures require external trust registries; embedded keys never establish trust by themselves
- Persistence rule: stateful security identities must reopen with stable externally resolved key material
- Qualification rule: elapsed-time and external gates cannot be shortened, edited or self-certified
- Release rule: current signed manifest must verify before imports or qualification execute
